_note: Synthetic cards for placement without a seam (07-ENGINE-QUALITY §4.1–4.3). Compact form, expanded by skeleton.mjs into the SeamGraph contract: a piece is [name, areaMm2] or [name, areaMm2, twinName, 'identical' | 'mirror']; a seam is [nameA, nameB, score], each on a fresh edge; `rivals` [[i, j]] says seam j is within the ambiguity of seam i (ambiguousWith). Names are made up, not a card's.

strips._why: Two strips of one front (upper larger than main) and a BOTTOM pocket with no seam to either: the pocket goes onto the main strip by its position word, before the strips meet.

bag._why: A bag of two identical panels (inner, outer; no body) and a belt of two layers whose seam fits both alike, each a rival of the other: the belt goes onto ONE panel now (the first on the card) as a decision, before the panels meet.

halves._why: Two identical halves of a side pocket bag sewn to each other, one named for the back (PCK_B_L): not layers — one goes onto the front, the other onto the back.
